title: The Operational Value of Spatial Dependence in Renewable Forecast Scenarios for Single-Period Economic Dispatch: A Controlled Ablation Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.23988v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Renewable forecasts are evaluated by statistical skill (e.g., CRPS), but grid operators pay for realized dispatch cost. We diagnose what drives dispatch value in a single-period newsvendor-style economic dispatch using real public data from two European transmission systems (CWE, DE-4TSO). Spatial coherence across forecast sites falls below the pre-specified 1% practical-significance threshold: a controlled ablation holding per-zone marginal forecasts bit-identical and varying only cross-zone dependence (10 configurations, 3 seeds, paired-bootstrap confidence intervals) shows a coherence gain of at most 0.64% of dispatch cost, indistinguishable from zero in 3 of 10 configurations, reached only under an unrealistic 8-fold forecast-error stress test. translated_title: 可再生能源预测场景中空间相关性对单周期经济调度的运行价值：一项受控消融研究
translated_abstract: 可再生能源预测通常以统计技巧（如CRPS）来评估，但电网运营商实际承担的是调度成本。我们利用来自两个欧洲输电系统（CWE、DE-4TSO）的真实公开数据，诊断在单周期报童式经济调度中驱动调度价值的因素。跨预测站点之间的空间相干性低于预先设定的1%实际显著性阈值：一项受控消融实验在保持各区域边际预测完全一致的前提下仅改变跨区域相关性（10种配置、3个随机种子、配对自助法置信区间），结果显示相关性带来的收益最多仅为调度成本的0.64%，且在10种配置中有3种与零无异，该收益仅在不符合现实的8倍预测误差压力测试下才能达到。决策导向训练（decision-focused training）是该领域已确立的范式，可带来稳健的2.82-5.19%的收益提升。参数化的高斯copula近似在现实误差水平下与经验copula相匹配……
tldr: 该研究通过受控消融实验发现，可再生能源预测场景间的空间相关性对单周期经济调度的运行价值微乎其微（最多0.64%），远低于决策导向训练带来的稳健收益（2.82-5.19%）。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled ablation study, this paper shows that spatial dependence in renewable forecast scenarios provides negligible operational value (at most 0.64%) for single-period economic dispatch, far less than the robust gains achieved by decision-focused training (2.82-5.19%).
